chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Ahmad ibn Idris (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Khazzaz, from Talha ibn Zayd, from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said:

The Messenger of God (may God's blessings be upon him and his family) said: Gabriel came to me from my Lord, exalted is His majesty, and said: O Muhammad! Indeed, God, Mighty and Majestic, conveys His greeting of peace to you and says: Give glad tidings to your brother Ali that I will not punish one who aligns with him, nor will I show mercy to one who opposes him.

key_terms.تولاه: Tawalla - to align with, follow, accept the authority of; in Shia theology, specifically refers to accepting the wilayah of Imam Ali
key_terms.عاداه: Opposes, shows enmity toward; the opposite of tawalli
key_terms.يقرئك السلام: Conveys the greeting of peace to you; a special divine honor

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about those who follow or oppose Imam Ali?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (s) relates that the Angel Gabriel brought a divine message specifically about Imam Ali (as). Allah conveyed His greeting to the Prophet and instructed him to give Ali the glad tidings that divine protection extends to Ali's followers, while those who oppose him will be denied mercy. This hadith, narrated through the chain of Imams from Imam al-Sadiq back to the Prophet, underscores the theological significance of wilayah (allegiance to Ali) in Shia Islam.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Husayn b. Ahmad b. Idris (ra) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Khalid from al-`Abbas b. Ma`ruf from Muhammad b. Yahya al-Khazzaz from Talha b. Zayd from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad form his father from his forefathers (as). He said:

The Messenger of Allah (s) said: Gabriel came to me from Allah and said: “O Muhammad! Surely, Allah recites the salaam to you, and says, ‘Give glad tidings to your brother, `Ali, that I will not punish one who aligns with him, nor will I grant mercy to one who opposes him.’”
